# models.dev catalog data

Mira's bundled provider catalog contains a normalized snapshot of the public
models.dev API: <https://models.dev/api.json>.

The upstream project is maintained at <https://github.com/anomalyco/models.dev>
and is licensed under the MIT License. The snapshot records its source URL,
SHA-256 source revision, and retrieval time in each model's metadata. Catalog
values are advisory and do not prove provider capabilities.
